verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents first-party prompt management. The API and SDKs can "manage prompts," the MCP integration can "author prompts," Playgrounds offer a no-code workspace for iterating on prompts, and stored prompts are a named data type. However, nothing shows that prompts are versioned (only datasets are described as versioned) or that prompt changes can be deployed to production without a code release. missing for 10: explicit prompt version history/pinning, a documented runtime prompt-loading or deployment/environment mechanism that decouples prompt changes from code shipping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
